  • Atuar de forma integrada com dados, arquitetura e governança.
  • Contribuir para a definição e adoção de práticas de MLOps e IA responsável.
  • Produzir documentação técnica e relatórios metodológicos.

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência e conhecimentos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em desenvolvimento e aplicação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Domínio de Machine Learning, Deep Learning e métodos estatísticos.
  • Vivência em avaliação e explicabilidade de modelos.
  • Conhecimento em MLOps e gestão do ciclo de vida de modelos.
  • Noções sólidas de ética, governança e uso responsável de IA.


Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido - Brasília - Distrito Federal.

Contratação CLT - Por tempo indeterminado.

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;

Auxílio creche;

Wellhub;

title: Sales Director
description:
Location: Brasilia, Sao Paolo, Florianopolis


Today’s world faces increasing security challenges. Threats are everywhere, invisible, virtual, and sophisticated. Traditional methods to address and prevent these threats are no longer enough.

Technology is changing incredibly fast. Malicious actors understand it, and they are taking advantage. We know it too.


For 30 years, the incredible minds at Cognyte around the world have worked closely together and put their expertise to work, to keep up with constantly evolving technological and security trends and help make the world a safer place with leading investigative analytics software solutions.


We are defined by our dedication to doing good and this translates to business success, meaningful work friendships, a can-do attitude, and deep curiosity.


We are seeking an exceptional and passionate Sales Director to join our Brazil Sales team.


As a Cognyter you will be:

  • Developing and growing the company business in the assigned territory.
  • Generating and executing sales opportunities while achieving the assigned sales target quota.
  • Managing a healthy and sustainable funnel with constant growth.
  • Leading sales activities for innovative and complex solutions in the investigative and intelligence domains in the region.
  • Mapping customer existing applications and technologies, and proactively identifying potential needs and opportunities.
  • Overall responsibility for all account activities and customer satisfaction level and loyalty;
  • Generating and executing an accurate, timely, and professional sales strategy plan, and account planning achieving high customer satisfaction;
  • Creating and managing sales and target plans for each partner - challenging results and cost-efficiency.


For this mission you’ll need:

  • At least 10 years of experience in leading/managerial positions in software sales positions preferably in the Governmental and Public sectors.
  • Relevant professional background in intelligence investigations, defense, or security environments, providing strong domain credibility with customers and partners.
  • Experience and skill set in partners’ development & management, business analysis, relationship building, business development.
  • Experience working with System integrators is a must. Ideally, this will include experience working with regional/local and large government and/or channels and resellers .
  • Demonstrated experience managing a team, including accountability for direct reports, workload planning, and performance reviews.
  • Experience establishing and managing channel partnerships (resellers, strategic partners, ecosystem players) to support and grow indirect sales.
  • Experience working in the big data, analytics ecosystem.
  • Team player with proven experience in this field and proven ability to manage complex relationships and nurture them to success.
  • Ability to operate in a complex matrix environment and drive processes internally.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing multiple industry opportunities, and the ability to prioritize partner efforts and investment based on ROI and other identified success factors.
  • Proven track record building a multi-channel pipeline and successfully moving opportunities through the sales cycle.
  • An independent self-starter: you thrive in fast-paced environments and feel comfortable with a high level of responsibility and ambiguity.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Fluency in English (native or advanced proficiency);
    additional languages are an advantage.


Remember: When you're curious enough, you don't need to check every box to apply. Be in touch!


We believe that diverse teams drive the greatness of ideas, products, and companies. Whatever your gender, age, race, creed, or taste in music – if you're curious enough, we’re waiting for you.


Apply now.

title: Gerente Regional Comercial – Autosserviço (As) | Brasilia
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais.   • Gerenciar indicadores e metas com visão estratégica , acompanhando diariamente volume, faturamento, tendências e comportamento das marcas no mercado, tomando decisões rápidas e assertivas.
  • Liderar e desenvolver equipes regionais , promovendo engajamento, cultura de alta performance e crescimento profissional, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes nacionais.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes-chave e áreas internas , assegurando sinergia e execução de excelência.

title: Rust Developer
description:
About You

You are a senior software engineer who enjoys building high-performance, reliable, and secure systems. You’re passionate about low-level efficiency, correctness, and modern software design, and you thrive in environments where performance, safety, and scalability truly matter.

You’re looking for a role where you can influence technical decisions, work on challenging backend systems, and collaborate with strong engineering teams while continuously sharpening your Rust expertise.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience using Rust in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of Rust’s ownership model, lifetimes, memory safety, and concurrency patterns.
  • Experience building high-performance backend services, APIs, or system-level components using Rust.
  • Strong knowledge of asynchronous programming in Rust (e.G., Tokio, async/await).
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, gRPC, or other service communication patterns.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and data persistence strategies.
  • Experience with testing, debugging, and performance profiling in Rust.
  • Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and system-level concepts.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, and maintainable architectures.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance and reliable backend systems using Rust.
  • Build and optimize services with a strong focus on performance, safety, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, DevOps, product) to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable Rust code following best practices.
  • Debug complex issues related to concurrency, memory usage, and system performance.
  • Integrate Rust services with external systems, APIs, and data stores.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and continuous improvement of development processes.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
  • Mentor other engineers and share knowledge around Rust best practices when applicable.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Aws Devops Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.G., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

Estamos em expansão e buscamos fortalecer nosso time de Ciência de Dados , impulsionando análises avançadas que otimizam processos agrícolas por meio de dados geográficos e espaciais. O(a) profissional irá integrar o time de Data Science, atuando na manipulação, análise e modelagem de dados complexos, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras no setor agro.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Realizar modelagem de dados e modelagem analítica , aplicando métodos estatísticos e matemáticos a problemas reais.
  • Processar, integrar e analisar dados geográficos e espaciais , utilizando ferramentas como PostGIS e bibliotecas Pandas, GeoPandas, Geocoder, Rasterio, GDAL, NumPy e Redis .
  • Aplicar técnicas analíticas em casos como mapeamento de solos, monitoramento territorial, análises espaciais e previsões baseadas em dados geoespaciais .
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (produto, tecnologia e negócio) para integrar soluções de dados aos fluxos operacionais.
  • Garantir qualidade, performance e escalabilidade por meio de testes, depuração e otimização de código.
  • Criar relatórios, análises e visualizações de dados para apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Física, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em modelagem analítica e desenvolvimento em Python .
  • Sólido conhecimento em processamento e análise de dados geográficos .
  • Experiência prática com bibliotecas como Pandas, GeoPandas, Rasterio, NumPy e bancos de dados espaciais.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e habilidade para resolver problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalho em equipe.
  • Português fluente (inglês técnico é um diferencial).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial .


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com machine learning aplicado a dados espaciais (Scikit-learn, TensorFlow ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em cloud computing , especialmente GCP , para processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Portfólio ou projetos anteriores envolvendo análise espacial, geoprocessamento ou ciência de dados aplicada .


O que Oferecemos

  • Plano de saúde.
  • Vale-refeição.
  • Convênio com psicologia e nutricionista.
  • Oportunidades de capacitação, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com espaço para propor soluções e gerar impacto real no agronegócio sustentável.

title: Advogado
description:
A AEL está em busca de uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, comprometida e com espírito de equipe, voltada a solução de questões complexas e com foco na melhoria do ambiente e dos negócios da empresa, por meio de seu conhecimento jurídico e atuação interpessoal. Este(a) profissional terá a oportunidade de se desenvolver em um ambiente de excelência e trabalhar em um mercado singular, com clientes, fornecedores e parceiros de diversas nacionalidades.


Nessa posição você terá o desafio de

  • Atuar na elaboração e revisão de minutas contratuais, tais como contratos de fornecimento, prestação de serviços, acordos de confidencialidade (NDA) e memorandos de entendimento (MOU);
  • Prestar suportejurídico e negocial para as áreas da empresa;
  • Realizar o gerenciamento de escritórios terceirizados e suas atividades;
  • Assessorar de forma consultiva demandas de cunho jurídico e de Compliance.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente capacidade de redação jurídica, negociação e análise de contratos, habilidades de pesquisa jurídica e resolução de problemas complexos;
  • Boa habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita e ser capaz de lidar com diferentes situações e clientes, adaptando-se a mudanças e desafios;
  • Graduação em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB);
  • Desejável possuir experiência em departamentos jurídicos de empresas;
  • Desejável especialização, pós-graduação ou cursos de extensão em contratos, direito empresarial e/ou tributário;
  • Inglês avançado.


O que a AEL te proporciona

  • Política de horários flexível e modelo híbrido: Atuamos com banco de horas e um dia de atuação remota, proporcionando uma rotina flexível
  • Plano de Saúde Unimed: Custos de adesão subsidiados pela AEL
  • Seguro de Vida: Zelamos pela sua proteção e de seus familiares
  • Vale Alimentação e Refeitório: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefícios Flash e contamos com refeitório na empresa
  • Auxílio Mobilidade/Vale Transporte: Facilitamos o seu deslocamento diário com opções que se adaptam à sua rotina
  • Estimulamos o equilíbrio da vida pessoal e profissional: Temos um calendário anual de feriados e férias coletivas, visando estimular o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional
  • Celebramos nossas conquistas: temos diversas ações de confraternização e reconhecimento, celebrando os atingimentos da jornada
  • Auxílio idioma: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento através do aprimoramento em inglês
  • Prêmio de fim de ano: Reconhecemos os desafios atingidos ao fim do ano
  • Incentivos à prática de atividades físicas: Investimos na sua saúde através de grupos de corrida, ginástica funcional e ginástica laboral
  • Bebê AEL: Celebramos a chegada de novos membros das famílias
  • Empresa Cidadã: Contamos com dias estendidos de licença maternidade e paternidade


Sobre a AEL Sistemas:

Excelência faz parte da nossa cultura. Está em tudo o que fazemos, nos processos, na forma de ser e inovar. A cada dia, o nosso potencial criativo se materializa na tecnologia de ponta que desenvolvemos. Aqui valorizamos as relações humanas, amigáveis e plurais, identificando os momentos em que é preciso seguir a formalidade e reforçar a nossa experiência.


Somos uma empresa genuinamente brasileira. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Consultor(A) De Vendas
description:
A +A Educação é uma edtech de ensino superior e profissional que habilita a transformação digital de seus parceiros, por meio de uma plataforma de experiência educacional. Está presente em mais de mil instituições de ensino superior (IESs), contribuindo para impactar mais de 3,5 milhões de alunos.


Atendemos integralmente as necessidades de IESs, sociedades científicas e hospitais, oferecendo um ecossistema integrado de alta tecnologia, conteúdo de qualidade e serviços voltados à educação.


Nosso comercial é responsável por todo o ciclo de venda – desde a captação até o fechamento . Somos inquietos, temos muita energia e vontade de fazer acontecer!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Você será responsável por conduzir todo o processo de venda, desde o primeiro contato com o cliente até o fechamento.


Suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar atendimentos por texto e voz, mantendo uma comunicação clara e personalizada;
  • Criar conexão com os clientes, entendendo suas necessidades para oferecer a melhor solução;
  • Manter o CRM sempre atualizado com os dados e status de cada cliente;
  • Acompanhar suasmétricas de desempenho (metas, indicadores e taxas de conversão);
  • Observar o mercado, identificar tendências e trazer insights relevantes para a operação.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência prévia com vendas;
  • Experiência comInside Sales será considerado um diferencial;
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação, tanto escrita quanto verbal;
  • Capacidade de conduzir uma venda com raciocínio estruturado e uso de storytelling ;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de CRM ;
  • Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint);
  • Cursos ou certificações em vendas, negociação ou atendimento ao cliente são diferenciais.


Soft Skills (Competências Comportamentais):

  • Autonomia para tomar decisões rápidas e eficazes em um ambiente dinâmico;
  • Paixão por educação e vontade de contribuir com o propósito da +A Educação ;
  • Foco em resultados e adaptação a cenários de crescimento acelerado e mudanças constantes;
  • Proatividade e ambição no atingimento de metas;
  • Curiosidade e interesse em se aprofundar nos processos, sempre buscando melhorias contínuas.


Etapas do processo

  1. Cadastro
  2. Entrevista com RH
  3. Entrevista com Gestão
  4. Teste Técnico
  5. Proposta

title: Lead Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Lead Developer


You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.


Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:


  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:


  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced understanding development using JavaScript frameworks.
  • Advanced English
  • Experience with Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology;
    remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards;
    trains technical staff on new technologies.


HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:


  • Nice to have, develop frontend framework for other teams
  • Develop frontend web applications in NodeJS and React
  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.


*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: Cloud Solutions Engineer (Infrastructure) - Bra
description:
Cloud Solutions Engineer (Infrastructure)

Reports To: IT Manager

Department: Information Technology

Location: Hybrid – Bumenau, Brazil


About MTech Systems

At MTech Systems, our mission is to increase yield in protein production to help feed the growing world population—without compromising animal welfare or the planet. We build cloud-first software that delivers real-time data across the protein supply chain, empowering producers with insights to improve operations responsibly.

With over 200 employees globally and customers in 20+ countries, MTech Systems is a leader in live animal protein production performance management. Our U.S. headquarters is in Atlanta, GA, where we foster a collaborative, flexible, and mission-driven work culture.


Job Summary

We are seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong customer-facing experience to join our IT team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of cloud architecture, automation, and customer success. You’ll work closely with internal teams and external customers to design, deploy, and support scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud infrastructure—primarily in Microsoft Azure.

You’ll play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, supporting SaaS deployments, and ensuring our customers have a seamless experience with our cloud-hosted solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong emphasis on communication, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure to support customer-facing applications.
  • Collaborate with product, development, and customer success teams to ensure infrastructure meets customer needs and SLAs.
  • Lead cloud onboarding and deployment efforts for new customers, including infrastructure provisioning, networking, and security configuration.
  • Optimize cloud costs and performance through proactive analysis and automation.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to customers and internal stakeholders on cloud best practices, security, and architecture.
  • Document infrastructure designs, runbooks, and customer-specific configurations.
  • Provide Tier 3 support for cloud-related issues and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Stay current with emerging cloud technologies and recommend improvements to our cloud strategy.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 2 years in a customer-facing or consulting role.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Azure , including Azure AD, networking, storage, and compute services.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell , Bash , or Python .
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Administrator Associate .
  • Experience with hybrid cloud environments and legacy system integration.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding , technical account management , or solution architecture .
  • Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.G., SOC 2, ISO 27001).


Why Join Us?

  • Work on meaningful projects that support global food sustainability.
  • Collaborate with a passionate, international team.
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid work environment and opportunities for growth.
  • Make a direct impact on customer success and product innovation.




EEO Statement

Integrated into our shared values is MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. MTech aims to maintain a global inclusive workplace where every person is regarded fairly, appreciated for their uniqueness, advanced according to their accomplishments, and encouraged to fulfill their highest potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

title: Rust Developer
description:
About You

You are a senior software engineer who enjoys building high-performance, reliable, and secure systems. You’re passionate about low-level efficiency, correctness, and modern software design, and you thrive in environments where performance, safety, and scalability truly matter.

You’re looking for a role where you can influence technical decisions, work on challenging backend systems, and collaborate with strong engineering teams while continuously sharpening your Rust expertise.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience using Rust in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of Rust’s ownership model, lifetimes, memory safety, and concurrency patterns.
  • Experience building high-performance backend services, APIs, or system-level components using Rust.
  • Strong knowledge of asynchronous programming in Rust (e.G., Tokio, async/await).
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, gRPC, or other service communication patterns.
  • Familiarity with databases (SQL and/or NoSQL) and data persistence strategies.
  • Experience with testing, debugging, and performance profiling in Rust.
  • Knowledge of Linux environments, networking fundamentals, and system-level concepts.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, clean code, and maintainable architectures.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance and reliable backend systems using Rust.
  • Build and optimize services with a strong focus on performance, safety, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (backend, frontend, DevOps, product) to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical decision-making.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and maintainable Rust code following best practices.
  • Debug complex issues related to concurrency, memory usage, and system performance.
  • Integrate Rust services with external systems, APIs, and data stores.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, and continuous improvement of development processes.
  • Maintain clear technical documentation throughout the SDLC.
  • Mentor other engineers and share knowledge around Rust best practices when applicable.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Coordenador (A) De Recursos Humanos | Pará
description:
A Aegea, criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Missão do Cargo

Atuar como parceiro estratégico do negócio, conectando a estratégia organizacional às práticas de gestão de pessoas da Aegea, garantindo execução com excelência dos processos e subsistemas corporativos, atuação orientada por dados e alavancagem dos resultados do negócio por meio de pessoas, com responsabilidade sobre a governança de remuneração.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar, desenvolver a performance e apoiar o time de Business Partners, assegurando atuação estratégica e alinhada às diretrizes de Pessoas & Cultura;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) de negócios da liderança local, apoiando a tomada de decisão em temas de gestão de pessoas, cultura, desempenho e clima organizacional;
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) de negócios em temas relacionados ao atendimento e orientação aos colaboradores, especialmente em assuntos como jornada de trabalho, benefícios, pagamentos, remuneração e demais políticas de pessoas, garantindo clareza, equidade e aderência às diretrizes corporativas;
  • Desdobrar e garantir a implementação das estratégias, políticas e programas corporativos de RH nas unidades do Pará;
  • Conduzir processos de desenvolvimento de lideranças, desempenho, metas, planos de desenvolvimento, sucessão, feedback e fortalecimento da cultura organizacional;
  • Consolidar, acompanhar, analisar indicadores de gente (recrutamento, turnover, absenteísmo, engajamento, diversidade, desempenho, jornada de trabalho, custo de pessoal, capacitações, entre outros), apresentando nos rituais de gestão para Gerência de RH e lideranças, como também agir proativamente propondo análise de causa e planos de ação estruturados e sustentáveis;
  • Garantir a qualidade da atuação consultiva dos BPs junto às lideranças e colaboradores, promovendo alto nível de relacionamento, escuta ativa e influência;
  • Direcionar e acompanhar processos junto ao time de BPs a temas relacionados a cultura organizacional, mudanças estruturais, marca empregadora, comunicação interna, iniciativas estratégicas da região;
  • Atuando em interface contínua com os subsistemas de Recursos Humanos (Talent Acquisition, Desenvolvimento Organizacional, Remuneração, Benefícios, Relações Trabalhistas, Folha de Pagamento, DHO, entre outros), assegurando integração, fluidez dos processos e soluções completas para o negócio;
  • Assegurar conformidade com a legislação trabalhista, políticas internas e práticas éticas, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos e a sustentabilidade do negócio;
  • Representar a área de Pessoas & Cultura em fóruns regionais, fortalecendo a governança e a agenda estratégica de gente.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Gestão Estratégica,Desenvolvimento Organizacional, Negócios ou áreas afins (desejável);
  • Experiência necessária e consolidada em Business Partner de RH Sr., com atuação estratégica em negócios junto à liderança e vivência em utilities, serviços públicos, ambientes industriais, operacionais ou de múltiplas unidades;
  • Experiência prévia em ferramentas de gestão e desenvolvimento de equipes de RH/BPs, incluindo People Analytics, acompanhamento de performance e produtividade, feedbacks e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em processos de DHO, legislação trabalhista, jornada de trabalho, acordos, políticas internas e mitigação de riscos trabalhistas;
  • Conhecimento e adaptabilidade a gestão de sistemas de RH e ferramentas de gestão (SAP Success Factors e outras de mercado, plataformas de performance, dashboards, Excel/Power BI e recursos Microsoft Office avançado;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuar de forma presencial e com mobilidade para viagens, conforme necessidade das unidades do Pará.


Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e orientação para o negócio, conectando a agenda de Pessoas & Cultura às prioridades e resultados organizacionais;
  • Liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação consistente na gestão do time de BPs, promovendo alinhamento, accountability e alta performance;
  • Influência, relacionamento e parceria com a liderança, atuando de forma consultiva, ética e assertiva;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e forte habilidade interpessoal, garantindo relações de confiança com líderes, parceiros e colaboradores;
  • Equilíbrio emocional, com maturidade para lidar com pressão, conflitos e situações sensíveis, mantendo postura ética e imparcial;
  • Tomada de decisão baseada em dados, utilizando indicadores e análises para orientar escolhas e planos de ação;
  • Adaptabilidade e gestão da mudança, atuando com flexibilidade em contextos dinâmicos e de transformação;
  • Disciplina e comprometimento com prazos, assegurando consistência na gestão com a equipe, parceiros e clientes internos, foco em entrega e qualidade das soluções;
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e foco no cliente interno, atuando de forma integrada com os subsistemas de RH e áreas do negócio.


Nós oferecemos:

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

description:
Airswift is seeking an experienced Crane Operator to join an offshore project team. The professional will be responsible for operating cranes safely and efficiently, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards and procedures during lifting and load-handling operations.


Location: Offshore – Brazil


Contract Type: Temporary (3 to 6 months), with possibility of extension depending on project progress and performance.


Start Date: Immediate availability required.


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate cranes for lifting and moving loads in accordance with safety and operational procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and company standards during cargo handling.
  • Perform pre-operation checks and routine inspections of lifting equipment.
  • Collaborate with rigging teams to ensure safe and efficient load movement.
  • Maintain accurate records of operations and report any equipment issues or safety concerns.
  • Participate in safety meetings and training sessions as required.


Requirements

  • Certifications:
  • CBSP + HUET or THUET
  • NR35 – Work at Heights
  • NR11 – Load Handling
  • Basic Rigger Training
  • Crane Operator Training
  • Language: Advanced English (mandatory).
  • Experience: Proven experience as a Crane Operator in offshore environments.
  • Skills: Strong safety awareness, teamwork, and ability to work under challenging conditions.
  • Additional Information
  • Work Schedule: Offshore rotation 14x14
  • Contract Duration: 3 to 6 months, with potential extension.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.


Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);
    Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Business Operations Associate (Remote)
description:
Company Description

Evergreen Permits specializes in helping homeowners, contractors, and developers in Seattle simplify the permitting process for small residential remodeling projects. With a team of experienced architects and designers, we ensure compliance with local building codes while saving our clients time and effort. Our services include creating as-built drawings, architectural drafting, detailed documentation, and managing seamless permit submissions. Our mission is to take the hassle out of the paperwork, making remodel projects straightforward and stress-free for our clients.

We’re a small (but growing) architectural permit services company building a smarter, faster way to serve contractors and other blue-collar builders—an audience that’s been overlooked for way too long.

This role is for someone who thrives on building structure from scratch: systems, workflows, SOPs, and the day-to-day operations that keep everything moving. Early on, you’ll wear multiple hats. Over time, the systems you help create will become standalone roles as we scale.


What you’ll own (initially)

  • Answering phone calls and returning missed calls
  • Sales calls (not pushy sales calls, just explaining what we do)
  • CRM implementation + management (pipeline hygiene, automations, reporting)
  • Screening web submissions and routing qualified leads to the sales team
  • Coordinating with marketing team
  • Building systems and SOPs across the company so we can train future hires fast
  • Meeting regularly with the owner to plan, build, and improve these systems together


Who we’re looking for:

  • Excellent spoken English. You will be talking to potential customers very often and communication is key for this role
  • Ability to work during Seattle business hours - 8am-5pm PST / 1pm-10pm GMT-3
  • You are self-motivated and autonomous—you don’t need constant direction
  • You like creating order: checklists, templates, systems, and repeatable processes
  • You’re comfortable using modern tools such as: CRM (Hubspot or similar), Monday, Microsoft Suite, Excel, Word, automation tools like Zapier, understanding project boards & scheduling tools.
  • You're a kind person. We're a curated group of highly motivated people that respect and show kindness to others. We want to learn from you and visa-versa
  • You’re excited about using AI thoughtfully to move faster and work smarter
  • You communicate clearly, follow through, and keep things organized
  • Bonus if you’ve supported a founder, managed operations, or helped implement a CRM before


Why this role is different

You’ll be building the operational foundation of a company with real momentum—helping turn a messy early stage into a machine we can scale.


Qualifications

  • Strong Administrative Assistance and Clerical Skills
  • Exceptional Phone Etiquette and Communication Skills
  • Experience in Executive Administrative Assistance
  • Proficiency in using office software and organizational tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience preferred
  • Prior experience in a permitting, architecture, or construction-related field is a plus


Benefits

  • Remote contractor role with autonomy to manage your day while collaborating closely with our US team.
  • Pay: between R$ 3,200 – R$ 4,000 depending on experience
  • Competitive starting pay depending on experience.
  • Two weeks of paid time off per year plus eight paid US holidays (you may swap any holiday for one you observe) and one week off in December for a total of around 1 month PTO.
  • Ongoing mentoring by the owner, process improvement, and client management.
  • Clear career path—grow into senior role starting on the ground floor of an exciting one of a kind company
  • We’re an early-stage company fulfilling a clear demand in the building and construction industry, so joining us now means getting in on the ground floor with plenty of room to move up as we scale.

title: Técnico(A) De Serviços - Rj
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Técnico de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.


Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas, diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.E. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento,monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você distingue prontamente entre o que é relevante e o que é irrelevante para compreender situações complexas. Você encontra pontos em comum e conduz as coisas para o consenso, garantindo que todos se sintam ouvidos. Você utiliza insights dos clientes para impulsionar e orientar o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam constantemente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação Técnica em Automação;
  • Ter experiênciacomprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa Cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Rust Developer
description:

You’re looking for a role where you can influence technical decisions, work on challenging backend systems, and collaborate with strong engineering teams while continuously sharpening your Rust expertise.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience using Rust in production environments.

Nossos 10.000 funcionários estão comprometidos em tornar o mundo do trabalho um lugar melhor para todos , mais seguro, eficiente e fácil de usar

Com 1.500 funcionários, nossa linha de negócios MOVE no Brasil é a maior do grupo . Estamos agora regionalizando nossas operações MOVE em nível LATAM, proporcionando assim exposição internacional e oportunidades para nossos funcionário s. Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor


Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso .


Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade.

Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.


The Senior Project Manager is a transit industry veteran with a proven track record for leading the design, development, and implementation of Transit ITS projects. A dynamic leader, with excellent communications, interpersonal skills, acknowledged industry experience, the Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading project teams, managing resources, adherence to schedule performance, and managing the financials of projects throughout the full development life cycle. This also includes management of issues, risks, and project change requests to ensure successful and on-time project delivery.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage all aspects of a project, including planning, organization, and implementation of project activities, ensuring projects are managed in line with scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards
  • Provide overall project communication to stakeholders and meet project requirements and stakeholder expectations
  • Serves as primary point of contact with the customer of the project and keeps customer appraised of project progress
  • Manage and oversee all project activities, such as issue tracking and risk mitigation, facilitating project team meetings and preparing/delivering status reports
  • Work closely with cross functional departments (Deployment, Engineering Design, Installation, and Field Service) to ensure successful execution of projects
  • Established a working relationship with the customer’s stakeholders and maintains good communication correspondence with customer.
  • Assembles appropriate team to meet and exceed project expectations
  • Provide direction and control of work performed in the framework of project, including monitoring the critical path and implementation of appropriate corrective actions
  • Coordinate and perform review of the project deliverables, software and hardware, and report on project performance
  • Manage and plan with the Systems Engineering and Product/Engineering team leads for technical review of system design and documentation with the customer
  • Establishes a project plan and schedules according to established company practices, polices, tools and templates.
  • Establishes milestones and monitors adherence to program master plans
  • Manages financial schedule performance of assigned projects
  • Maintains and keeps scheduling of assigned projects and communicates schedule changes as necessary
  • Manages full lifecycle of project and ensures each aspect of the project is completed
  • Manages procurement of equipment and materials necessary to execute on projects
  • Develops subcontractors’ scopes of work, executes subcontracts and manages subcontractors as may be necessary
  • Coordinates with Sales and Account Managers to further sales opportunities
  • May coordinate proposal preparation, including standards of work and specifications, estimation of product and service costs.
  • May participate in negotiation and administration of contracts
  • Travel required for onsite at customers facility up to 40%
  • Adheres to company processes and policies.


Skills Required:

  • 10+ years’ experience as a Project Manager in a technical or engineering environment with a focus on delivering projects to external customers.
  • B.S. Degree and or 5+ Years as a Project Manager in and ITS environment
  • PMP certification or equivalent preferred.
  • Experience in transit industry.
  • Strong computer skills, including MS Office Suite, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook as well as ability to learn new software programs such as Microsoft Dynamics AX
  • Strong team building and leadership skills. Ability to lead the team.
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Strong verbal and written communications, presentation, and persuasive skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Strong negotiation and influence skills


Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Analista De Sistemas Sênior - .Net
description:
Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor versátil para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de nossos sistemas. O desafio envolve criar novas aplicações em arquitetura moderna e dar sustentação a sistemas legados críticos para o negócio. Procuramos alguém que tenha curiosidade e disposição para entender regras de negócio em códigos antigos e transformá-las para o futuro.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações e APIs utilizando Microsoft .NET (C#) .
  • Analisar e dar manutenção em sistemas legados, garantindo estabilidade durante migrações.
  • Participar de projetos de modernização tecnológica, refatorando regras de negócio para novas arquiteturas.
  • Realizar Code Reviews e aplicar boas práticas (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Otimizar consultas e realizar performance tuning em SQL Server .


Requisitos:

  • Formação: Superior completo em TI (Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas).
  • Experiência:
  • C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+, ASP.NET Web API.
  • Banco de dados SQL Server (T-SQL, Stored Procedures).
  • ORM (Entity Framework ou Dapper).
  • Git e Visual Studio.
  • Uso de IA em desenvolvimento de software" (Github Copilot)


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em VB6 para manutenção/migração de sistemas legados.
  • Experiência em projetos de modernização (migração de monólitos para microsserviços).
  • Certificações Microsoft (AZ-204, AZ-400) e cursos em Arquitetura de Software, Design Patterns e Refatoração de Código Legado.

title: It Governance Coordinator
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados do mundo nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com um dos portfólios mais amplos de seguros do mercado, comercializamos nossos produtos através do canal de vendas do banco Santander Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na ZS nos preocupamos em manter um ambiente que contemple a diversidade. São oferecidas oportunidades iguais e todos os candidatos são considerados qualificados para as vagas, sem discriminação por motivos de deficiência, sexo ou orientação sexual, gravidez ou licença-maternidade, raça ou origem nacional ou étnica, idade, religião ou crença, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano protegido (se aplicável) ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.


Hoje estamos procurando um IT Governance Coordinator. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, aqui é o seu lugar!


Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?


  • Elaboração do orçamento anual de TI (Capex e Opex)
  • Controlar os orçamentos de TI (Capex e Opex) no dia a dia (BAU)
  • Identificar oportunidades de eficiência financeira (redução de custos e aumento de eficiência operacional) junto aos responsáveis de TI
  • Gerir e criar planos de melhoria contínua de processos financeiros de TI
  • Criar e apresentar relatórios financeiros e KPIs para a diretoria de tecnologia.
  • Acompanhar os fluxos de pagamentos de responsabilidade da TI.
  • Gestão de contratos e aquisições de TI, supervisionando demandas e gerenciando finanças desde o início do contrato até sua evolução, incluindogerenciamento de renovações
  • Desenvolver e Implementar Frameworks- Criar e manter estruturas de governança de TI, como COBIT e ITIL, para padronizar processos e garantir a excelência operacional.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Compliance - Assegurar que as práticas de TI estejam em conformidade com regulamentações, políticas internas e padrões de segurança, gerenciando riscos de TI (Auditorias e rotina de controles internos)
  • Monitoramento e Melhoria Contínua, monitorando o desempenho de TI, identificando áreas de melhoria e promovendo a automação e padronização de processos.
  • Gestão de pessoas


Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?

  • Superior em Economia, Administração, Tecnologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com análise de relatórios financeiros e projeções.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel, Power Point e ferramentas de reportes (Ex. Power BI)
  • Conhecimentos em ERP's de mercado.
  • Conhecimentos em Políticas e Riscos, Processos de governança de TI;
  • Experiência comFerramentas ITSM
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de governança (COBIT, ITIL, ISO).
  • Experiência em gestão financeira de TI (orçamento, custos).
  • Forte conhecimento em segurança da informação, auditoria e compliance.


Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:

  • Liderança e comunicação
  • Idioma: Espanhol será um diferencial
  • Visão estratégica e de negócios.
  • Pensamento analítico
  • Comunicação e habilidade de apresentações


Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor ?

Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.


Junte-se à nossa equipe!

#Juntosprotegemosoquemaisimporta


O CANDIDATO reconhece que, ao enviar o Curriculum Vitae e/ou preencher a candidatura a uma vaga de emprego, fornecendo as informações ali contidas, aceita que os dados pessoais sejam utilizados pelo ZURICH SANTANDER para a avaliação decorrente do processo seletivo. Como essa é a única finalidade de análise para avaliação do candidato, essas informações poderão ser compartilhadas com empresas que nos apoiam na avaliação do processo seletivo. Os dados do CANDIDATO serão guardados com o máximo de cuidado e atenção, e serão mantidos pelo período de tempo previsto em lei.

title: People Solutions Global Survey Strategy Lead
description:
Lockton is the world’s largest privately held independent insurance brokerage and advisory firm, known for its entrepreneurial spirit, client-first mindset, and collaborative culture. Without outside shareholders, Lockton focuses entirely on delivering innovative solutions that help clients succeed.


In our People Solutions business, we partner with organizations to design benefits, total rewards, and workforce strategies that attract, retain, and engage top talent. From growing companies to global enterprises, we combine deep expertise with actionable insights to create solutions that truly support people and business goals.


Lockton is a great place to work because we value ownership, innovation, and growth. Associates are empowered to make an impact, share ideas, and develop their careers in a culture that emphasizes inclusion, collaboration, and excellence. At Lockton, you can do meaningful work, grow professionally, and be part of a team that genuinely cares about clients and colleagues alike.


The Role

We are seeking a senior leader to shape and execute the strategy, design, governance, and advanced analytics of survey programs that support client decision-making across People Solutions, including employee benefits, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation. This role focuses on translating complex people strategies and plan design considerations into structured, scalable, and data-driven insights for large and multinational employers.

The position requires deep expertise in employee benefits, total rewards, advanced survey methodology, applied social science judgment in question design, and senior leadership in automated analytics and insight generation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, execution, and governance of global and regional surveys supporting People Solutions priorities, leveraging enterprise survey platforms such as Qualtrics.
  • Establish and maintain methodological and technical standards to ensure data quality, consistency, confidentiality, scalability, and longitudinal comparability across clients and geographies.
  • Design and oversee automated survey workflows in Qualtrics, including complex logic, validation rules, versioning, and multi-country deployment.
  • Apply principles from social science, behavioral economics, and organizational psychology to design survey questions that elicit accurate, reliable, and decision-useful responses from senior HR, Total Rewards, Finance, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop survey frameworks that capture people strategy, benefits philosophy, workforce governance, and risk management practices while minimizing response bias and misinterpretation.
  • Design survey content addressing detailed plan provisions and non-cash compensation, including retirement programs, health and welfare benefits, equity-based compensation, deferred compensation, and other non-cash rewards.
  • Lead the development of scalable, automated analytics pipelines to process survey data, reduce manual intervention, and support repeatable benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Partner with analytics and technology teams to integrate Qualtrics outputs with data visualization, benchmarking, and reporting tools (e.G., dashboards and standardized executive reporting).
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, translating automated survey outputs into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Present survey findings to executive audiences with clarity and credibility, supported by standardized and dynamic reporting.
  • Interpret survey data to identify market trends, emerging risks, and opportunities across industries and regions.
  • Partner with actuarial, legal, tax, rewards, and other People Solutions specialists to ensure technical accuracy and regulatory alignment.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Lockton’s People Solutions survey and benchmarking capabilities through innovation, digital enablement, and analytics-led insights.
  • Provide executive-level oversight, coaching, and quality assurance for consulting and analytics teams involved in survey design, automation, and analysis.
  • Support business development efforts by shaping survey-led client solutions, proposals, and market-facing offerings.


Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Sociology, Organizational Behavior, Anthropology, Political Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in people strategy, total rewards, employee benefits, or human capital consulting, preferably within a large professional services or advisory firm.
  • Deep knowledge of People Solutions offerings, including employee benefits, total rewards, workforce strategy, and non-cash compensation plan design.
  • Extensive experience designing and deploying surveys using Qualtrics, including advanced logic, governance controls, and global distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze survey results in an automated, scalable manner, supporting benchmarking, trend analysis, and executive reporting.
  • Proven experience applying social science or behavioral research principles to survey design, including question framing, response bias mitigation, and construct validity.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite and senior client stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent).
  • Graduate or advanced study in organizational psychology, behavioral science, economics, sociology, public policy, human factors, or survey methodology, applied in a consulting or business context.
  • Experience integrating Qualtrics with analytics, BI, or data platforms (e.G., Power BI, Tableau, SQL-based environments).
  • Familiarity with governance, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to people programs and compensation.
  • Experience leading or scaling repeatable, productized survey and benchmarking solutions.

title: Coordenadora De Estilo (Hope Resort)

title: Pessoa Especialista Ii - Staff Engineer – Tribo De Incentivo E Fidelização
description:
Descrição da vaga

Se você procura uma empresa com ambiente inovador e desafiador, que incentiva criatividade e autonomia para ultrapassar barreiras e conquistar resultados, você poderá juntar-se ao nosso time de #LoucosPorPontos! Buscamos profissionais engajados e estrategistas, que sonham alto e fazem acontecer para colecionar sucessos com o nosso time :)


Todas nossas vagas abertas são para todas as pessoas independente de gênero, idade, etnia, raça, orientação sexual ou deficiência.


Missão do cargo


Definir, sustentar e evoluir a direção técnica dos produtos da Tribo de Incentivo e Fidelização, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, eficiência operacional e capacidade de inovação, enquanto eleva o nível técnico dos times e reduz riscos e dívidas técnicas estruturais.

  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de referência da tribo (Solução e Aplicação);
  • Garantir aderência a padrões arquiteturais, guias técnicos, ADRs, patterns e antipatterns;

Integração e Sistemas Distribuídos

  • Garantir integração eficiente e segura entre squads, produtos e parceiros externos;
  • Desenhar soluções orientadas a eventos, APIs e integrações de alta escala;
  • Assegurar resiliência, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas.

  • Atuar como referência técnica para Tech Leads e Engineers.
  • Influenciar decisões além do seu squad, impactando toda a tribo.
  • Facilitar alinhamentos técnicos entre produto, engenharia e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Exercitar liderança informal, promovendo autonomia com coerência técnica.


Mentoria & Desenvolvimento

  • Mentorar Tech Leads e engenheiros seniores;
  • Apoiar evoluçãotécnica, planos de carreira e formação de sucessores;
  • Elevar o nível de maturidade técnica da tribo de forma consistente.


Saúde Tecnológica & Qualidade

  • Identificar, priorizar e garantir tratamento da dívida técnica estrutural;
  • Dar visibilidade à saúde tecnológica da tribo para GPMs e Tech Managers;
  • Atuar como corresponsável pela qualidade técnica das entregas;
  • Trabalhar com indicadores técnicos e evolução ao longo do tempo.


Visão de Médio e Longo Prazo

title: Gerente Industrial - Injeção Plástica
description:
Buscamos: Gerente Industrial para atuar em um Multinacional do setor Automotivo . Será responsável por liderar uma planta com foco em injeção plástica, garantindo a eficiência produtiva através da gestão das áreas de Produção, Processos e Manutenção.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar áreas de Produção, Processos e Manutenção , assegurando alta performance e redução de desperdícios;
  • Implementar e monitorar sistemas de qualidade automotiva (IATF 16949, ISO 9001) e práticas de Lean Manufacturing e Kaizen ;
  • Garantir conformidade com normas ambientais e de segurança (ISO 14001, NR12);

title: Sales Manager-Motion Control & Industrial Automation-Brazil
description:
We are looking for a Regional Sales Manager based in Brazil, responsible for expanding our automation business across Brazil and the entire South American region.

This includes building strong relationships with distributors, system integrators, OEMs, and industrial end users in key markets such as Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and others.


The ideal candidate understands LATAM’s industrial automation market, has experience dealing with regional distributors, and can operate independently to scale our PLC, HMI, servo, and motion control business.


Responsibilities

1. Regional Business Development Across South America


  • Develop and manage business opportunities in Brazil, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and other South American markets.
  • Establish strong relationships with industrial customers in key sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (offshore platforms, drilling systems, pump control, skid automation)
  • Mining (conveyors, crushers, hoisting systems, process automation)
  • Food Processing & Packaging (filling lines, bottling lines, labeling & sealing machines)
  • Robotics & Automation (robot OEMs, integrators, palletizing/packaging robots, AMRs/AGVs)
  • Identify automation upgrade projects, machine builder opportunities, and OEM/ODM potential.

2. Distributor & System Integrator Network Expansion

  • Recruit and evaluate partners in Brazil and across LATAM with strong technical capability and service teams.
  • Assess integrators serving the above industries (mining automation integrators, food packaging integrators, oilfield service SIs, robotics integrators).
  • Provide training on products, applications, and industry-specific solutions.
  • Jointly drive business opportunities, technical proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • 3. Sales Management & Project Execution
  • Lead opportunity development from first contact to contract signing.
  • Prepare technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers tailored to industry requirements.
  • Track project progress (pilot runs, commissioning, FAT/SAT), coordinating with China-based engineering teams.
  • Oversee regional pricing strategy, inventory planning, and distributor sales performance.
  • 4. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
  • Analyze competition in motion control and PLC/HMI markets (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider, Omron, Delta, WEG, Bosch Rexroth).
  • Understand industry-specific requirements:
  • Oil & Gas → explosion protection, extreme environment reliability
  • Mining → heavy-duty servo/VFD, dust & vibration resistance
  • Food Packaging → high-speed motion control, hygiene requirements
  • Robotics → EtherCAT, CANopen, servo performance, safety functions
  • Provide structured feedback to HQ regarding product localization, certifications (INMETRO), and market gaps.
  • 5. Marketing, Events & Branding
  • Represent the company at major industrial exhibitions in LATAM (FEIMEC, FIEE, EXPOMAFE, EXPOMIN, Colombiatex, Expoagro).
  • Organize seminars, workshops, and roadshows with distributors.
  • Deploy demo units for partners and key customers across industries.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related technical fields.
  • 5–10 years sales or business development experience in one or more of the following sectors:
  • Oil & Gas (onshore/offshore automation)
  • Mining & heavy industry automation
  • Food processing & packaging machinery
  • Robotics, motion control, and industrial automation
  • Strong understanding of LATAM’s industrial automation ecosystem (OEMs, integrators, distributors).
  • Proven track record managing regional distributors and large industrial accounts.

description:

Location : São Paulo, Brazil

Department : Client Engagement

Reports to : Client Engagement Managing Director


Job Overview:

Join a fast-growing FinTech reinventing how businesses manage risk and transact worldwide.


Deaglo is looking for a driven Client Engagement Associate to join our Brasil Client Engagement Team. We empower corporates, asset managers, and financial institutions around the world with cutting-edge, data-driven Global risk management, accounting, and technology solutions across FX and interest rates.


As part of the Client Engagement Team, you will play a hands-on role in driving commercial growth by identifying new opportunities, developing outbound strategies, and initiating conversations with key decision-makers across corporates and investment funds. This is a great opportunity for someone with early commercial experience who wants to take ownership and grow quickly in a high-performance environment.


Key Responsibilities:

What You’ll Do


Lead Generation & Market Research

  • Proactively identify and research potential clients through cold calls, outbound emails, social media, and digital tools.
  • Qualify leads based on Deaglo’s ideal customer profile and strategic fit.


Pipeline & Opportunity Development


  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline from initial contact through qualification.
